goal: Stop the automatic production qualifier reporting every risk for a CHECK constraint on a column added in the same ALTER TABLE; keep genuine risks failing, with tests.
prohibited_actions: No database write of any kind
required_checks: python -m pytest -q scripts/test_production_business_risk_gate.py -k "allowlist or new_column or unknown_statement or refused_production"
assumptions: Postgres validates an inline CHECK on ADD COLUMN with a full table scan, so downtime stays reported
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would excuse data loss or an access change
